Solr is part of 3 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2014.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (2) and [Web](@/projects/web.md) (1).

Most recently: [apollocrawler.com](@/work/apollocrawler-com.md): Website for apollocrawler.com; [craftsmen](@/work/craftsmen.md): Web UI for listing of czech companies; [solr-core-minimal](@/work/solr-core-minimal.md): Minimal config core for solr.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Solr: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Solr to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
